Vue2 SFC-TypeScript.description:
Vue Single-File Component with TypeScript.
`Vue.extend` gives the options object type inference on every Vue 2.x version.
On Vue 2.7+, `defineComponent` (prefix `vue-ts-defineComponent`) is preferred — it also types `setup()`.

Vue2 SFC-TypeScript, defineComponent.description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { defineComponent } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Vue Single-File Component with TypeScript. A no-op at runtime — it exists so TypeScript can infer props, `data`, `computed` and `setup()`.

Vue2 SFC-TypeScript Class-based.description:
Class-based Vue Single-File Component with TypeScript.
Requires the third-party [vue-property-decorator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vue-property-decorator) (built on `vue-class-component`) and `experimentalDecorators` in `tsconfig.json`.
Neither package is maintained for Vue 3 — on Vue 2.7 prefer `defineComponent` or `<script setup>`.
